title: The llama alias points to Scout
summary:
The `llama` alias moved to Scout, while authenticated requests got more queue room outside the seed tier.

The `llama` text-model name now selects Llama 4 Scout 17B rather than the separate Llama 3.3 70B model.

The queue cap for token-authenticated requests rose from 3 to 20 outside the seed tier. Seed remains capped at 3.

Nectar-tier requests bypass the queue only when token-authenticated. The same model update removed `openai-roblox` from the available text models.

highlights.title: Llama now selects Scout
highlights.text: Requests using `llama` now select Llama 4 Scout 17B instead of Llama 3.3 70B. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama).
